instruction.text:
Fill in the gap, using the infinitive with to.

After certain verbs, the infinitive is used.
instruction.sound: Fill in the gap, using the infinitive with to.

atoms.b: She refused ((to_accept)) the result without further investigation.
He offered ((to_help)) with the preparations despite his tight schedule.
The report aims ((to_highlight)) the impact of misinformation on public opinion.
They attempted ((to_reduce)) emissions without compromising economic growth.
The author agreed ((to_be)) interviewed under the condition of anonymity.
We were instructed ((to_report)) any suspicious activity immediately.
